mapping_rules: Every asset-factor relationship requires a documentary reference and SHA-256 evidence fingerprint.
Every mapping requires explicit human review.
A newly researched mapping becomes usable no earlier than reviewed_at and evidence_valid_from.
Historical exposures may not be reconstructed from today's sector label, company description, name keywords or current business mix alone.
Relationship class is descriptive only and does not imply positive or negative market direction.
Changes in business mix or exposure must be represented by a new versioned mapping interval rather than overwriting history.
